fact: Car 31 left the pit lane when the light at the end of the pit lane was red.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.3e of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The timing data shows the car crossed the line 1.11 seconds after the end of the session. However video evidence shows it is almost certain that the driver could not have seen the light change from green to red due to his close proximity to the line at the pit exit. Therefore although a breach of regulation was commited, in view of the mitigating circumstances of the driver being unable to see the red light, no penalty is applied.
title: Infringement Car 31 Leaving The Pitlane After The End Of The Session
